fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Gross Room Revenues; up to 0.5% incentive rebate for meeting standards. Marketing and Reservation Fee is 4% of GRR (max 5%). RediRewards Program fee is additional 4% of GRR from RediRewards members (max 5%). PMS fee is $490/month plus $3.85/room/month, increasable 5% annually. Revenue Management Software: 0.3% of GRR, min $100/month, max $400/month. Digital Performance Marketing: min 3% of applicable GRR, max 15%. Cooperative Contribution up to 1% of GRR if cooperative formed.
